purpose: Rerank complete eligible candidate sets only after governed offline comparison with the active ranking baseline.
limitations: Offline relevance labels and conversion are not causal treatment effects.
The model can rerank only the complete candidate set already approved by hard constraints.
Synthetic quality does not authorize shadow traffic or production promotion.
Diversity and new venue exposure gates must remain satisfied on future production evidence.
rollback: Disable the LambdaMART signal and restore the versioned baseline score with deterministic candidate-id tie breaking.
